# vaultwarden_item_attachment (Ephemeral Resource)

Use this ephemeral resource to download and decrypt an attachment of an item, from the personal vault of the provider user or from an organization, without saving its content in the Terraform plan or state. Its values can be used in other ephemeral contexts, such as provider configurations and write-only attributes. Requires Terraform 1.10 or later.

Requires `email` and `master_password` to be set in the provider configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read an attachment without saving its content in the plan or state (Terraform 1.10 and later)
ephemeral "vaultwarden_item_attachment" "service_account" {
  item_id = "a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  id      = "e5f6a7b8-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

provider "google" {
  credentials = ephemeral.vaultwarden_item_attachment.service_account.content
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the attachment
- `item_id` (String) ID of the item the attachment belongs to

### Read-Only

- `content` (String, Sensitive) Content of the attachment as a string, `null` when it is not valid UTF-8
- `content_base64` (String, Sensitive) Content of the attachment, base64-encoded
- `file_name` (String) Name of the attachment
- `size` (Number) Size of the encrypted attachment in bytes
- `size_name` (String) Size of the encrypted attachment in a human-readable form, such as `1.2 KB`
